name: X Square Robot
summary:
X Square Robot develops embodied AI models, robot-learning tools and physical systems for manipulation. Its work includes the WALL-B world model, data-acquisition hardware and methods for connecting visual and language understanding with continuous robot control.

The company develops simulation techniques for predicting physical actions and evaluating policies, alongside interfaces for collecting human demonstrations. Its HOST research explores learning new manipulation skills from a single human video, while XRZero-G0 supports collection of motion and interaction data. These efforts connect robot hardware, training data and models, with the aim of transferring useful skills into real physical environments.
